data.title: The lamp that flickered

memoryNodes.cue: The light does not work as expected.
Dr Chen checks before deciding what to change.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 陈博士先检查，再决定改什么。

memoryNodes.cue: One part may be removed for inspection.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 可以取下一个部件进行查看。

data.situation:
On their next visit to the college, Dr Chen showed Maya a standard desk lamp at his workbench. It had no unusual features, but today it did not function properly: the light flickered. Maya thought the whole device might be faulty. Dr Chen asked her to make a thorough check before deciding what was wrong. He laid out the tools beside the lamp and unplugged it before examining the loose part. Dr Chen: Let us go through the notes from the last check.
Maya: The shade was loose then, too.
Dr Chen: I can remove it and examine the fitting.
Jo: Will you need to modify the design?
Dr Chen: Perhaps. First, I will check whether a small adjustment is enough.

乔：需要修改设计吗？
陈博士：也许。先看看小调整是否足够。

glossary.zh: 普通规格的；没有特别功能的
glossary.note: 形容词，本例为常规型号；与质量标准名词区分。
glossary.example: They used a standard desk lamp without special features.
glossary.exampleZh: 她们使用没有特别功能的普通台灯。

externalEvidence.definition: conforming to or constituting a standard of measurement or value; or of the usual or regularized or accepted kind

glossary.note: 动词 function properly；与功能名词分别教学。
glossary.example: The lamp does not function properly.

glossary.zh: 为特定用途设计的装置
glossary.example: The lamp is a simple electrical device.
glossary.exampleZh: 台灯是简单的电气装置。

externalEvidence.definition: an instrumentality invented for a particular purpose

glossary.zh: 有故障、不能正常工作的
glossary.note: faulty equipment/device；未检查前不直接认定原因。
a thorough check/investigation；不是快速扫一眼。
glossary.example: Dr Chen made a thorough check of the lamp.
glossary.exampleZh: 陈博士全面仔细地检查台灯。

glossary.note: tool/tools 单复数归一；本例实物工具。
glossary.example: He laid the tools beside the lamp.

externalEvidence.definition: an implement used in the practice of a vocation

glossary.note: go through notes/details；本例不是经历困难。
glossary.example: They went through the notes from the last check.
glossary.exampleZh: 她们仔细检查上次的记录。

externalEvidence.label: Oxford Learner’s Dictionaries
externalEvidence.reviewFinding: Carefully examine notes; no forced lived-experience or consuming sense.

glossary.note: remove something from；本例将部件移离原位置。
glossary.example: Dr Chen removed the loose shade.

externalEvidence.definition: remove something concrete, as by lifting, pushing, or taking off, or remove something abstract

glossary.note: modify a design/fitting，通常局部调整。
glossary.example: He modified the fitting rather than replacing the whole lamp.
glossary.exampleZh: 他修改连接部位，没有更换整盏台灯。

externalEvidence.label: Oxford Learner’s Dictionaries
externalEvidence.reviewFinding: Partly adapt a design; local broad change definition not forced over this nuance.
